name: Alliance of Lordaeron
summary: Across the Eastern Kingdoms, the Alliance of Lordaeron once held the Old Horde at bay. Seven human kingdoms joined with Khaz Modan dwarves, Wildhammer gryphon riders, gnomes, and high elves in the Second War, under Supreme Commander Anduin Lothar and King Terenas Menethil II. Political fractures and the Scourge broke the coalition during the Third War, yet its legacy endures in today’s Alliance.

sections.title: A Coalition Born in Ashes
sections.body: After Stormwind fell in the First War, Regent Lord Anduin Lothar led its battered refugees across the Great Sea to Capital City. There he pleaded their cause before King Terenas Menethil II. The king called the human rulers to council, though old rivalries and border tensions divided them. The Horde’s threat outweighed those disputes. The seven human nations chose Lothar as Supreme Commander and bound themselves in a desperate pact.

sections.title: The Second War and the New Vanguard
sections.body:
The Alliance faced brutal orcish warriors, dark warlocks, and monstrous red dragons. Archbishop Alonsus Faol and Lothar formed the Knights of the Silver Hand, raising holy paladins such as Uther the Lightbringer to counter the Horde’s dark magic. Fighting spread across the Hinterlands, and the siege of Aerie Peak was broken. Then Kurdran Wildhammer pledged his gryphon riders to the skies.

Soon after, the Bronzebeard dwarves and Gnomeregan gnomes were freed. They joined the high elven rangers under Alleria Windrunner. King Perenolde of Alterac betrayed the coalition, but the Alliance drove the Horde back to Blackrock Spire and broke its dominion.

sections.title: Fracture and Ruin
sections.body:
Victory left bitterness in place of lasting peace. Disputes flared over the taxes needed to keep the orc internment camps and rebuild Stormwind. Gilneas saw little gain in remaining, built the Greymane Wall, and cut ties. Stromgarde departed over disputes about territory and prisoners, while Quel'Thalas withdrew behind its enchanted runestones. King Terenas tried to hold together the coalition that remained.

During the Third War, the Cult of the Damned and the Plague of Undeath swept across Lordaeron and dismantled it. Arthas Menethil’s betrayal tore out the kingdom’s heart and ended the golden age of the northern realm.

faq.q: What was the Alliance of Lordaeron?
aliases: who was in the first alliance
faq.answer: The Alliance of Lordaeron united the Seven Kingdoms of humanity, the dwarves of Ironforge and Aerie Peak, the gnomes of Gnomeregan, and the high elves of Quel'Thalas against Orgrim Doomhammer’s Horde in the Second War.

faq.q: Why was the Alliance formed in Capital City instead of Stormwind?
faq.answer: Stormwind had been conquered and destroyed in the First War. Regent Lord Anduin Lothar led the surviving people north by ship to Lordaeron, where he warned King Terenas Menethil II of the alien threat.

faq.q: Who led the Alliance of Lordaeron?
faq.answer: King Terenas Menethil II hosted the coalition and guided its diplomacy. Sir Anduin Lothar became Supreme Commander of its armed forces, and Daelin Proudmoore served as Grand Admiral of the fleets.

faq.q: Why did Alterac betray the Alliance?
faq.answer: King Aiden Perenolde feared the Orcish Horde could not be stopped, so he secretly made a deal with Warchief Orgrim Doomhammer. Alterac offered safe passage through its mountain passes in return for being spared from slaughter.

faq.q: Why did the Alliance of Lordaeron fall apart?
aliases: what happened to the old alliance
faq.answer: After the Second War, disputes over the cost of internment camps and rebuilding Stormwind led Gilneas, Stromgarde, and Quel'Thalas to secede. The remaining coalition was later destroyed in the Third War, when Prince Arthas and the Scourge annihilated Lordaeron.

faq.q: How is this different from the Alliance of today?
faq.answer: The Alliance of Lordaeron centered on the northern kingdoms around Capital City and Dalaran. Today’s Alliance centers on the rebuilt southern kingdom of Stormwind and includes the night elves of Kalimdor, while drawing inspiration from Lothar’s coalition.

angles.text: The memory of the Alliance of Lordaeron gives the modern Alliance, centered in Stormwind, its ideals and sense of purpose.
Archbishop Alonsus Faol and Anduin Lothar created the Knights of the Silver Hand as the Alliance of Lordaeron’s holy shock troops.
The Alliance brought all Seven Kingdoms under one banner for the only time since the ancient Empire of Arathor. Regional rivalries and the Scourge later scattered them.
The Ironforge Bronzebeards and the Wildhammers of Aerie Peak forged their modern ties to human civilization in the battles of the Second War.
